answer: Tie value to social recovery. An identity can only restore its keys through attestations from established peers who have interacted with it — real history, real relationships. A farm’s thousand wallets have no such web: no one will vouch for a sockpuppet, so the moment the ledger flags the cluster, every wallet’s accumulated value dies unrecoverable. Risk spirals upward for the operator: the fleet is worth only what each wallet can recover, and none can. Honest identities sit in the river’s delta of verified channels; fake ones are stagnant pools the current never reaches.
